description: This file is a shell script used to run performance tests related to writing a Git index cache. It sets up a repository conditionally, performs a write-cache operation multiple times, and indicates test completion.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Initializes or resets a test repository to a default state.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the given commands.

methods.name: test-tool write-cache
methods.description: Performs the cache writing operation used in performance testing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
